companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
About the Team
Our Sales and Success team supports Canva Enterprise, with a mission to get Canva into the hands of every team, classroom and business in the world.
Canva Enterprise helps organisations bring design, content creation and collaboration together under one secure and centralised platform. From Whiteboards and Docs to Presentations and Magic Studio, we’re helping teams across organisations create, communicate and collaborate at scale.
Our Sales team partners with customers across functions and industries to understand their biggest challenges, show what’s possible with Canva and build lasting partnerships that help organisations unlock more value from visual communication. You’ll work closely with teams across Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Post-Sales to help some of our largest customers transform the way they work.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
What you’ll do (responsibilities)

As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that’s all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you’ll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Building and executing strategic account plans: You’ll take a data-led approach to identifying, prioritising and engaging high-value enterprise opportunities. You’ll analyse market dynamics, customer priorities and whitespace to translate strategy into focused account plans and sales activity.
  • Driving pipeline and revenue growth: You’ll own complex sales cycles from prospecting through to close, building a healthy pipeline, forecasting accurately and using Salesforce to create visibility and momentum across your portfolio.
  • Leading complex enterprise engagements: You’ll navigate large, matrixed organisations, multi-threading across stakeholders and building relationships with senior decision-makers to uncover business challenges and shape compelling solutions.
  • Putting customers at the centre: You’ll use compelling storytelling, thoughtful discovery and a strong understanding of customer needs to create a sales experience that feels relevant, personalised and valuable.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
What we're looking for

  • You have significant experience owning full-cycle enterprise sales, with a strong track record of new-logo acquisition and consistently delivering against ambitious revenue targets.

  • You’ve worked with large, named accounts, ideally across complex or global organisations, and know how to build thoughtful account strategies that create momentum over time.

  • You’re confident navigating complexity, uncovering business challenges and translating them into clear, commercially compelling solutions.

  • You know how to multi-thread across an organisation, build relationships with senior and executive stakeholders and create alignment across multiple decision-makers.

  • You can develop detailed account plans that bring together customer priorities, stakeholder maps, commercial opportunities and clear next steps.

  • You’re a compelling communicator who can bring ideas to life in both virtual and face-to-face environments, particularly with senior audiences.

  • You have a strong track record of leading complex commercial negotiations and progressing opportunities through long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • You’re comfortable operating in ambiguity, adapting quickly and maintaining momentum in a fast-moving environment.
